summary: Ballard Power Systems filed a routine Form 6-K attaching a news release dated November 5, 2026, announcing the series-production debut of its FCmove-SC fuel cell engine in the new-generation Solaris Urbino 12 hydrogen transit bus. No securities, ownership, or corporate-action terms are disclosed; the item is a commercial product and supply-agreement milestone following an extension of the companies' long-term supply agreement. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, price, or regulatory clock is stated. This is an ordinary business announcement, not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
